summary: The recorded base reproduces the reported DeepSeek-V4 assertion before NEXTN alias resolution. At the exact candidate commit, the model hook accepts NEXTN, applies the same top-k constraint as EAGLE, and the later speculative hook canonicalizes NEXTN to EAGLE. The candidate's focused regression and independent boundary cases pass. No native source changed. Full DeepSeek-V4-Flash TP=2 server loading was not run because the assigned host has one AMD gfx950 GPU and no model weights, rather than the reported two NVIDIA sm_120 GPUs.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual DeepSeek-V4 model-hook then speculative-hook ordering. NEXTN failed in apply_deepseek_v4_defaults with the issue's assertion before alias resolution.
Candidate regression: NEXTN acceptance and canonicalization, NEXTN top-k rejection, existing EAGLE/DSPARK acceptance, and unrelated NGRAM rejection; 4 tests and 2 subtests passed.
Independent direct path: NEXTN topk=1 and EAGLE topk=1 both resolve to EAGLE; NEXTN/EAGLE topk=2 reject; DSPARK remains accepted by the model hook; NGRAM and noncanonical lowercase nextn reject.

Broader server-argument regressions: 302 passed and 2 platform-sensitive context-parallel tests failed because HIP explicitly rejects deprecated prefill CP. The failures are outside the changed DeepSeek-V4/speculative path.

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch enumerated one AMD Instinct MI355X with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. The reviewed defect is deterministic argument processing and required no GPU kernel execution; no full model or numerical GPU claim is made.

remaining_limitations: The reported DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights were unavailable, so model loading and generation were not exercised.
The host has one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), not two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs (sm_120); TP=2 and the reported NVIDIA backend combination were not reproduced.
No native files differ between base and candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The broader server-argument suite has two unrelated HIP-specific context-parallel failures (302 passed, 2 failed).
